_doc: Transparent score: each term maps a catalogue number to a desirability d in [0,1] with a trapezoid band [a,b,c,d] (0 outside a..d, rising a->b, 1 between b and c, falling c->d); score = sum(w*d)/sum(w). Edit here, then run: python3 foundry/sweep.py shortlist (never recomputes a world). Group totals are shown in shortlist.json. A world is DISQUALIFIED only when start_ok is false (playability), never for taste.

mmr._doc: greedy diversity: adjusted = score - lambda * max similarity to already chosen worlds of the same province
